project.name: MOBAFire
project.summary: Long-running community guide platform (League Classic and TFT, plus sister Fire sites) where members create, share and discuss champion guides and builds, with champion/item/rune databases, rune planner, ward map tool, tier lists, wiki and news.
project.patch: News block: "League of Legends Patch 26.23 Summary" by Fruxo, November 23, 2026; "TFT Enchanted Wilds: Patch 18.7" November 20, 2026
